title: Canonical circuits preserve logspace adjacency
statement: Let $C$ be a family of Boolean circuits, and suppose its size language, each of its gate-type languages, and its edge language are decidable in logarithmic space, and the family has polynomial size. Then the family obtained by replacing each circuit with its canonical form also has polynomial size and has size, gate-type, and edge languages decidable in logarithmic space.
hypotheses_covered: The size language of $C$ is in logarithmic space
For every gate type, the corresponding type language of $C$ is in logarithmic space
The edge language of $C$ is in logarithmic space
